  "id": "grade8-u3-l2",
  "title": "Objets, personnes et informations du voyage",
  "titleFr": "Objets, personnes et informations du voyage",
  "unit": "Unité 3 · Le voyage",
  "language": "fr",
  "objectiveAr": "إتقان مفردات أدوات السفر والأشخاص ومواعيد الرحلات، مع استخدام avoir والتعبيرات الأساسية في السياق.",
  "objectiveFr": "Maîtriser le vocabulaire du voyage et utiliser avoir et les expressions essentielles en contexte.",
  "theme": {"icon":"🧳"},
  "contentSource": "curriculum-aligned lesson framework",
  "vocabulary": [
    {"word":"un passager","translation":"راكب","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/travel-passenger.svg","example":"Le passager attend le train.","pronunciation":"ss بين الحركات تُنطق /s/؛ و er في النهاية تُنطق /e/."},
    {"word":"une passagère","translation":"راكبة","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/travel-passenger-female.svg","example":"La passagère attend le bus.","pronunciation":"ss تُنطق /s/؛ و ère في النهاية تُنطق /ɛʁ/."},
    {"word":"un guichetier","translation":"موظف الشباك","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/ticket-clerk.svg","example":"Le guichetier vend les billets.","pronunciation":"gui تُنطق /gi/؛ ch تُنطق /ʃ/؛ و ier تُنطق تقريبًا /je/."},
    {"word":"un billet","translation":"تذكرة قطار أو طائرة","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/train-ticket.svg","example":"J'ai un billet de train.","pronunciation":"ill تُنطق /j/ تقريبًا؛ و t النهائية لا تُنطق."},
    {"word":"un ticket","translation":"تذكرة مترو أو أوتوبيس","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/transit-ticket.svg","example":"J'ai un ticket de bus.","pronunciation":"ck تُنطق /k/؛ و t النهائية لا تُنطق."},
    {"word":"une valise","translation":"حقيبة سفر","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/suitcase.svg","example":"J'ai une valise rouge.","pronunciation":"s بين حركتين تُنطق /z/؛ و e الأخيرة لا تُنطق."},
    {"word":"des horaires","translation":"مواعيد الرحلات","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/travel-schedule.svg","example":"Je regarde les horaires des trains.","pronunciation":"h في البداية لا تُنطق؛ و oi تُنطق /wa/ تقريبًا؛ و s النهائية لا تُنطق."},
    {"word":"un touriste","translation":"سائح","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/tourist-male.svg","example":"Le touriste visite la ville.","pronunciation":"ou تُنطق /u/؛ s بين حركتين تُنطق /z/؛ و e الأخيرة لا تُنطق."},
    {"word":"une touriste","translation":"سائحة","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/tourist-female.svg","example":"La touriste visite le musée.","pronunciation":"ou تُنطق /u/؛ s بين حركتين تُنطق /z/؛ و e الأخيرة لا تُنطق."},
    {"word":"un pharmacien","translation":"صيدلي","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/pharmacist.svg","example":"Le pharmacien travaille près de la gare.","pronunciation":"ph تُنطق /f/؛ c قبل i تُنطق /s/؛ ien تُنطق تقريبًا /sjɛ̃/."},
    {"word":"un passeport","translation":"جواز سفر","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/passport.svg","example":"J’ai mon passeport.","pronunciation":"ss تُنطق /s/؛ o تُنطق /ɔ/ تقريبًا؛ و t النهائية لا تُنطق."}
  ],
  "grammar": {"explanation":"نستخدم avoir للتعبير عما نملكه أو نحمله معنا أثناء السفر.","examples":[{"fr":"J'ai mon billet.","ar":"لدي تذكرتي."},{"fr":"Nous avons nos valises.","ar":"لدينا حقائبنا."},{"fr":"Elle a son ticket.","ar":"لديها تذكرتها."}]},
  "conversation": {"lines":[{"speaker":"Sara","fr":"Tu as ton billet ?","ar":"هل معك تذكرتك؟"},{"speaker":"Adam","fr":"Oui, j'ai mon billet.","ar":"نعم، معي تذكرتي."},{"speaker":"Sara","fr":"Tu connais les horaires ?","ar":"هل تعرف المواعيد؟"},{"speaker":"Adam","fr":"Oui, je regarde les horaires du train.","ar":"نعم، أراجع مواعيد القطار."}]},
  "practice": [{"question":"ما معنى un passager؟","options":["موظف الشباك","راكب","صيدلي"],"answer":1},{"question":"اختر الكلمة التي تعني حقيبة سفر.","options":["une valise","un ticket","des horaires"],"answer":0},{"question":"أكمل: J'ai mon ...","options":["passagère","billet","pharmacien"],"answer":1},{"question":"من يبيع التذاكر في الشباك؟","options":["un touriste","un guichetier","un passager"],"answer":1}],
  "assessment": {"questions":[{"question":"ما معنى un passeport؟","options":["جواز سفر","حقيبة سفر","تذكرة"],"answer":0},{"question":"أي كلمة تعني راكبة؟","options":["un passager","une passagère","une touriste"],"answer":1},{"question":"ما معنى un guichetier؟","options":["سائح","موظف الشباك","صيدلي"],"answer":1},{"question":"اختر الكلمة التي تعني حقيبة سفر.","options":["des horaires","une valise","un ticket"],"answer":1},{"question":"ما معنى des horaires؟","options":["مواعيد الرحلات","صيدلي","راكبة"],"answer":0},{"question":"أي جملة صحيحة؟","options":["J'ai mon billet.","Je mon billet ai.","J'ai le billet suis."],"answer":0},{"question":"من الكلمات التي تعني تذكرة مترو أو أوتوبيس؟","options":["un pharmacien","des horaires","un ticket"],"answer":2},{"question":"أكمل: Nous ... nos valises.","options":["avons","sommes","êtes"],"answer":0},{"question":"ما معنى un pharmacien؟","options":["موظف الشباك","صيدلي","سائح"],"answer":1},{"question":"أي جملة صحيحة في السياق؟","options":["La passagère attend le bus.","La passagère attends le bus.","La passagère attendre le bus."],"answer":0}]},
  "status":"standardized"
}
